mapper.insert: insert into sys_menu(parent_id, menu_name, path, component, perms, menu_type, icon, sort, status, delete_flag, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{menuName}, #{path}, #{component}, #{perms}, #{menuType}, #{icon}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{deleteFlag}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT sm.perms FROM sys_user su LEFT JOIN sys_user_role sur ON su.id = sur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu srm ON sur.role_id = srm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu sm ON srm.menu_id = sm.id WHERE su.id = #{userId} AND su.delete_flag = 0 AND sm.perms IS NOT NULL AND sm.perms != '' AND sm.status = 1 AND sm.delete_flag = 0
SELECT DISTINCT sm.perms FROM sys_menu sm WHERE sm.perms IS NOT NULL AND sm.perms != '' AND sm.status = 1 AND sm.delete_flag = 0
SELECT id,status FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{id}
select * from sys_menu where delete_flag = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE menu_ancestors AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, perms FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{menuId} UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.parent_id, m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN menu_ancestors a ON m.id = a.parent_id ) SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM menu_ancestors WHERE perms IN ('sys:manage', 'sys:recycle') )
